model_annotations.Bulgarian: Двете диаграми са кръгови диаграми, които визуализират състава на различни групи от сектори, като всяка диаграма представя шест сектора, като секторите са маркирани с процентни стойности вътре в тях и съответни етикети в легендата. model_annotations.English: The image displays two separate pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), each illustrating proportional distributions across multiple categories. Chart (a) is divided into six segments, each with a distinct pattern and labeled with its percentage: a light green segment at 15%, a green segment with a grid pattern at 17%, a blue segment with horizontal lines at 21%, a blue segment with diagonal lines at 31%, a yellow segment at 9%, and a light blue segment with vertical lines at 7%. Above the chart, a legend maps these patterns to the words “the”, “this”, “for”, “chemical”, “to”, and “in”. Chart (b) is divided into four segments, each with a distinct pattern and labeled with its percentage: a blue segment with diagonal lines at 38%, a pink segment with a grid pattern at 27%, a yellow segment at 19%, and a gray segment with dots at 15%. Above this chart, a legend maps these patterns to the words “the”, “$”, “equilibrium”, and “constatant”. Both charts have percentage values written directly inside their respective slices and do not include exploded or emphasized segments.
